svg.text: DYNAMIC TEMPLATE • MOVING ARROWS & LIVE PACKETS
How an Agent Actually Runs: The Core Loop That Repeats Until a Deterministic Gate Exits
Steps 2-5 iterate; Step 1 feeds context in; Step 5 is the only place the loop may end — the same gate exists in ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, and OpenHands.
Gemini or Gemma 3 decides tool vs. reply
Output grounding check, OpenTelemetry trace (Cloud Trace /
Langfuse), cost audit, verified answer with receipt.
WHAT IS ALLOWED TO END THE LOOP (STEP 5 GATE) — GOOGLE + OPEN-SOURCE KNOBS
Verification hook returns exit_code == 0 (pytest, schema, or
policy check) — the LLM saying 'done' is never sufficient.
max_steps = 15: ADK RunConfig • LangGraph recursion_limit • CrewAI

If sha256(tool + args) fails twice in a 5-turn window (Firestore
or Redis ZADD window), the 3rd attempt is blocked and a strategy
Tool result + state are written to Firestore or PostgreSQL
(LangGraph PostgresSaver / Temporal) so a crash resumes at step N
